from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,json,re,shlex,subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
task=Path("reports/T0008")
baseline=json.loads((task/"planning-baseline.json").read_text())
assert subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip()==baseline["head"]
for p,h in baseline["source_sha256"].items():
    actual=hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() if Path(p).is_file() else None
    assert actual==h,(p,actual)
assert len(baseline["source_sha256"])==19
docs=["docs/handoffs/T0008-ground-derivations.md","docs/decisions.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md","reports/T0008/planning-review.md"]
links=[]
for name in docs:
    p=Path(name);s=p.read_text()
    assert s.endswith("\n"),name
    assert all(line.rstrip()==line for line in s.splitlines()),name
    assert "\u200b" not in s,name
    for target in re.findall(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)]+)\)",s):
        if "://" in target or target.startswith("#"):continue
        dest=(p.parent/target.split("#",1)[0]).resolve()
        assert dest.exists(),(name,target)
        links.append((name,target))
s=Path(docs[0]).read_text()
assert "- 状态："+chr(96)+"ready"+chr(96) in s
assert "Counter(actual) == Counter(expected)" in s
assert len(re.findall(r"^- \[ \] A[1-7]：",s,re.M))==7
fence=chr(96)*3
for i,code in enumerate(re.findall(fence+"python\n(.*?)"+fence,s,re.S)):
    compile(code,f"handoff-python-{i}","exec")
bash=re.findall(fence+"bash\n(.*?)"+fence,s,re.S)
assert len(bash)==1
commands=[shlex.split(line) for line in bash[0].splitlines() if line.strip()]
assert len(commands)==4
for argv in commands:
    assert argv[:2]==[".venv/bin/python","reports/T0008/record_check.py"]
    assert argv[3]=="--"
    assert not (task/argv[2]).exists()
    if "-m" in argv:
        assert argv[4:7]==[".venv/bin/python","-m","pytest"]
        assert argv[-2:]==["--basetemp",f"reports/T0008/{argv[2]}/pytest-tmp"]
assert commands[-1][4:]==["git","diff","--check"]
expected_tests=["tests/test_derivations.py","tests/test_dependency.py","tests/test_proof.py","tests/test_engine.py","tests/test_reference_engine.py","tests/test_logic_types.py","tests/test_config.py","tests/test_doctor.py"]
assert commands[2][8:-2]==expected_tests
old=Path("reports/T0007/record_check.py").read_text()
expected=old.replace("T0007","T0008").replace("SOURCES = (\n",'SOURCES = (\n    "src/kmesh/logic/derivations.py", "tests/test_derivations.py",\n')
assert Path("reports/T0008/record_check.py").read_text()==expected
ast.parse(expected)
changed=subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only"],text=True).splitlines()
assert set(changed)=={"docs/decisions.md","docs/implementation_status.md","docs/handoffs/T0007-relation-dag.md"},changed
untracked=subprocess.check_output(["git","ls-files","--others","--exclude-standard","-z"]).decode().split("\0")
assert all(not p or p=="docs/handoffs/T0008-ground-derivations.md" or p.startswith("reports/T0008/") for p in untracked)
subprocess.run(["git","diff","--check"],check=True)
checks={"result":"PASS","task_status":"ready","baseline":baseline["head"],"source_snapshot_count":19,"old_sources_unchanged":True,"new_product_and_tests":"not_run; absent","local_link_targets_checked":len(links),"shell_commands_checked":4,"acceptance_items":7,"independent_design_review":"PASS; Counter fix re-reviewed","git_diff_check":"PASS","scope":"handoff and verification preparation only","artifact_sha256":{p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in docs+["reports/T0008/record_check.py","reports/T0008/planning-baseline.json","reports/T0008/.gitignore"]}}
(task/"planning-final-check/checks.json").write_text(json.dumps(checks,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(checks,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
